results.description: The Book of Enoch was thought to be lost for over 2000 years, until in 1773, a traveller brought three copies back from Ethiopia. Whether or not this ancient book was actually authored by Enoch, the father of Methuselah and great grandfather of Noah, is an ongoing debate amoung historians and theologians. But all recognise the Book of Enoch as one of the most important apocalyptic works outside of the Bible.This 1917 translation by R. H. Charles is professionally narrated by Christopher Glyn and aims to provide those who are curious to know the contents of this cryptic and mysterious book with an enjoyable way to do so.
